title: Find the distinct elements present in carcinogenic molecules that contain a
question: Find the distinct elements present in carcinogenic molecules that contain at least one triple bond and have an atom whose ID ends with '5'.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT a.XCL_003
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010
JOIN bond b ON a.XCL_002 = b.XCL_005
WHERE m.XCL_011 = '+'
  AND b.XCL_006 = '#'
  AND a.XCL_001 LIKE '%5'
